Ficheros por ruta en la última lectura:: Files per path at the last read:
Ninguna ruta incluida coincide con un fi: No included path matches a file in the repository. Check the paths in «Edit».
Una por línea, desde la raíz. Una carpet: One per line, from the root. A folder by its name (docs or docs/) comes in whole; «*» does not cross folders and «**» does. Only documents come in (Markdown, text, HTML, PDF and office files). Hidden files and key files (.env, *.pem, *.key, id_rsa…) never do, and everything goes through the secret detector.
Una por línea. Una carpeta por su nombre: One per line. A folder by its name comes in whole. Saving a change reads the repository again: what is left out leaves the index.
